<!--
  The simple compare (model compare@1): the heading, a description, a header row with the names of the two
  options, then the rows as a list, each a feature with the value of each option, in three columns on a bordered
  surface. Axes: width (wide: the full container, narrow: max-w-3xl).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { CompareLine } from "./compare-simple.types";

export type CompareSimpleProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  firstLabel: string;
  secondLabel: string;
  rows: CompareLine[];
  level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
  padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
  align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
  width?: "wide" | "narrow";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Container from "../compose/Container.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  description = "",
  firstLabel,
  secondLabel,
  rows,
  level = 2,
  padding = "standard",
  align = "center",
  width = "wide",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<CompareSimpleProps>();
const titleId = computed(() => id + "-title");
const column = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
  : "start"
);
const textAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
  : "text-start"
);
const itemsAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "items-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "items-end"
  : "items-start"
);
const selfAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "self-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "self-end"
  : ""
);
const narrow = computed(() => ((width as string) === "narrow") ? "mx-auto max-w-3xl" : "");
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="section"
    :class="
      (padding as string) === 'compact' ? 'py-8 lg:py-16'
      : (padding as string) === 'spacious' ? 'py-24 lg:py-40'
      : 'py-16 lg:py-32'
    "
    :aria-labelledby="(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
    data-slot="compare-simple"
  >
    <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
      <Stack gap="12" align="stretch" :class="narrow">
        <Stack gap="4" :align="column" :class="cn('max-w-2xl', selfAlign)">
          <Title :as="level" size="3xl" weight="bold" :class="cn('tracking-tight', textAlign)" :id="titleId">
            {{ title }}
          </Title>
          <Text v-if="description" size="base" :class="cn('text-muted-foreground', textAlign)">
            {{ description }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
        <Box class="flex w-full flex-col rounded border border-border">
          <Box :class="cn('grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 px-4 py-4', 'rounded bg-muted')">
            <Box class="w-full" />
            <Text size="sm" :class="cn('text-start', 'font-semibold')">
              {{ firstLabel }}
            </Text>
            <Text size="sm" :class="cn('text-start', 'font-semibold')">
              {{ secondLabel }}
            </Text>
          </Box>
          <List tag="ul" :class="cn('m-0 w-full list-none p-0', 'flex flex-col')">
            <ListItem v-for="r in rows" :key="r.id" class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 px-4 py-4" data-slot="compare-row">
              <Text size="sm" :class="cn('text-start', 'font-medium')">
                {{ r.title }}
              </Text>
              <Text size="sm" :class="cn('text-start', 'text-muted-foreground')">
                {{ r.first }}
              </Text>
              <Text size="sm" :class="cn('text-start', 'text-muted-foreground')">
                {{ r.second }}
              </Text>
            </ListItem>
          </List>
        </Box>
      </Stack>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
